Read on if you want to find out what new and great items are currently available in the Atomic Shop, including the free items of the week.

#### FREE ITEMS

![](https://images.ctfassets.net/rporu91m20dc/67QuW0UiBSGnCSl1OxmCEX/97e779f98af9a9bd6cb363251a61d9bf/VendorBot_FO1_1920_870.png)

In December, our players should show us the C.A.M.P.s they built using the free camera. What should we say? You overwhelmed us with your great C.A.M.P.s. As a thank you, we wanted to give ALL Fallout 76 players a free C.A.M.P. item. So grab your “Let the Dice Roll” neon sign.

The hour of romance has come for you in a pink suit. The suit is available to all Fallout 76 players until **7. February** free.

This time, Fallout 1st members can also register until **7. February** seize the merchant bot.
